notes.title: Update 2.3 - Climbing Fix
notes.content:
We have fixed several issues from our Discord channel.

    Climbing and muscle up bug fix
    Rewind time with climbing bug fix
    Menu selecting bug fix
    Calibration issue fix

If you spot any issues please report to our discord.
Thanks!

notes.title: Phoenix
notes.content:
-Incorporated all movement mechanics into the initial tutorial, including shooting.
-Made alterations to level design based on player feedback.
-Implemented two distinct running movement options, adjustable within the settings.
-Introduced a reverse jumping mechanic as an optional setting.
-Overhauled the bird shooting system.
-Introduced friendly birds to enhance visual aesthetics and facilitate aim practice.

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 6
notes.content: We finally added leaderboard support for best timeruns of each level!
